dashboard.label: OneDriveNag
dashboard.description: OneDrive sign-in prompts and sync health, from the OneDriveAdoption event source.

search.query: index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | stats dc(upn) as users
index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where match(stage,"Shown$") | stats count
index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where match(stage,"Acted$") | stats count

index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where isnotnull(upn) | stats latest(stage) as stage by upn | where stage!="Healthy" AND NOT match(stage,"SignedInElsewhere$") | stats count

index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where match(stage,"^(FirstLogin|Reauth)") | rex field=stage "^(?<prompt>FirstLogin|Reauth)(?<outcome>.+)$" | chart count over prompt by outcome
index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | timechart span=1d count by stage

index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where isnotnull(upn) | stats latest(stage) as stage latest(syncState) as syncState latest(_time) as lastSeen by upn | eval lastSeen=strftime(lastSeen,"%F %T") | sort stage

panel.title: Degraded and Unknown, by sync detail

search.query: index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where stage IN ("Degraded","StatusUnknown") | stats count dc(upn) as users by stage, syncDetail | sort - count

index=$idx$ SourceName=OneDriveAdoption | spath input=Message | where match(stage,"^(FirstLogin|Reauth)") | eval shown=if(match(stage,"Shown$"),1,0), outcome=if(match(stage,"Shown$"),0,1) | stats sum(shown) as shown sum(outcome) as outcomes latest(_time) as lastShown by computer, user | where shown>outcomes | eval lastShown=strftime(lastShown,"%F %T") | sort - shown
